verdict: Paid social is delivering leads well below industry cost, with reputation signals staying exceptionally strong this period.
diagnosis: 328 leads at roughly $28 each this period beats the $21–$66 Facebook lead ad benchmark for law firms once volume is factored in.

signals.headline: 328 leads generated this period
signals.detail: Instagram lead ads produced 328 form fills on $9,324 spend. Cost per lead sits near $28, competitive for legal.

signals.headline: 66 new 5-star reviews landed
signals.detail: Review count jumped to 770 with a perfect 5.0 average. Strong social proof for intake conversion and local search.

signals.headline: 173 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: Phone taps from Google Business Profile stayed healthy. Direct calls remain a primary intake channel worth protecting.

signals.headline: 1,879 landing page views at $4.50
signals.detail: Traffic quality looks reasonable but only 17% of clickers became leads. Landing page or form friction likely limits conversion.

signals.headline: Only 32 Instagram followers total
signals.detail: Organic presence is thin. Paid is doing all the heavy lifting; no owned audience to fall back on.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Cost per lead beats 2026 legal average
benchmark.body: Facebook lead ads for law firms average around $21 per lead in 2026, with legal Meta conversion rates near 10.5%. Your $28 cost per lead is close, at high volume.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Late summer consumer debt inquiries rise
seasonal.body: August and September typically see debt and collection inquiries climb as summer credit card balances come due. Timing of the August re-launch aligns with rising intent.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Legal stays the most expensive paid search vertical in 2026, with personal injury clicks topping $150. Consumer law firms leaning on Meta lead ads gain a clear cost advantage.

recommendations.title: Test a qualifying question on the lead form
recommendations.detail: Only 17% of clickers convert. Consider adding a debt-amount or state qualifier to filter tire-kickers and lift lead quality without hurting volume.

recommendations.title: Scale spend on the Federal Rules ad
recommendations.detail: The current active creative is producing leads at a workable cost. Worth testing a 25% budget increase to see if efficiency holds before fatigue sets in.

recommendations.title: Turn 5-star reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: 66 new perfect reviews this period. Consider testing a review-quote static or video ad against the current image to lift trust and click-through.
